csv_project_name: Consultant for Transit Route Analysis and Develop New Route
csv_scope_of_work: The City of El Monte (hereinafter referred to as "the City") is soliciting proposals from prospective firms ( Consultants ) with extensive experience working with public agencies to provide professional services. In addition to specific services identified in this RFP, it is the intent of the City that the selected firm will provide additional related support, as needed, based on the approved cost proposal summary or prior negotiated project specific fees. The City s Public Works & Utilities Department is requesting proposals from responsive and qualified Consultants to analyze the Transportation Services Division's existing routes and develop new supplemental routes as part of El Monte's Clean Mobility Nexus Project. The analysis shall include, but not be limited to, an evaluation of existing route performance, route productivity, rider boarding and alighting needs, stop utilization, service coverage, run cuts, scheduling efficiencies, opportunities for route modifications, the addition, relocation, consolidation, or removal of bus stops, and the identification of service gaps and unmet mobility needs.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
